data.name: Naazima
data.gender_notes: Naazima is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-z-m', meaning 'to rest', 'to be gentle' or 'to be soft'. The name Naazima is used to describe someone who is gentle, delicate, and peaceful in nature. The name Naazima carries the meaning “Gentle, Delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Naazima usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Naazima belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Delicate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naazima total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
